title: SM AC4C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 AC4C 励磁系统，包括自动电压调节器和励磁机，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator output gain, K_A (pu)} 调节器增益、{Regulator output time constant, T_A (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B (s)} 调节器滞后时间常数、{Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C (s)} 调节器超前时间常数、{Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} 调节器输出上限、{Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)} 调节器输出下限、{Voltage regulator input (voltage error) maximum limit, V_Imax (pu)} 指定电压误差的最大限值、{Voltage regulator input (voltage error) minimum limit, V_Imin (pu)} 指定电压误差的最小限值、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数，按实例取值。
